I for one would agree that Saerin is a reasonable choice and quite in Cadsuane's style. Cadsuane likely despises both Blue and Red, and so will probably stick with folks from the other Ajahs. In fact, any of the Black Ajah Hunters would make a reasonalbe choice. This is a hard question, since we don't know what Cadsuane thought of many Aes Sedai. She found the lot of them a scheming cabal of laughable old fools, that's for sure, further complicating the question.

Maybe Sanderson will give us a bisquit if we ask nicely for it?
